NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UCOLIS shares your location with the sender only during a delivery you have started.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: UCOLIS shares your location with the sender only during a delivery you have started, including in the background.
NSCameraUsageDescription: UCOLIS uses the camera to take photos of your parcels and documents.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UCOLIS accesses your photos to illustrate your parcels and send your documents.
